description: Send natural-language astrology questions to the Vedika API, with birth details when the operation requires them. Select Vedic, Western or KP through the documented system field; use conversationId for follow-up questions. Operation and language availability depend on the route and account plan. Response time depends on request complexity, answer length and selected tier. Review current billing terms at https://vedika.io/pricing before production use.

birthDetails.description: Birth details. Required for personal questions (chart, dasha, dosha, compatibility, career, health).

category.description: Query category hint for better routing. Auto-detected if omitted.

conversationId.description: ID from a previous response to continue a multi-turn conversation with context.

includeRemedies.description: Include BPHS-based remedies (gemstone, mantra, donation) for weak planets.

language.description: Response language code, for example en, hi or ta. Availability depends on the operation and account plan. Default: en.

partnerBirthDetails.description: Partner/second person birth details for compatibility questions.

question.description: Your astrology question in natural language. Confirm language coverage for the selected operation and account plan.

speed.description: Delivery tier. standard=best quality (default). fast=quicker, costs more. eco=lower-cost engine; an eco call on a deploy without the Eco engine fails closed with a masked 503 ECO_UNAVAILABLE and is never charged.

system.description: Astrology system. vedic=sidereal with nakshatras/dashas/yogas (default). western=tropical with transits/aspects. kp=Krishnamurti sub-lord analysis.

name: vedika_ai_chat
